BATCH A APPROVED as one batch — every FIX recommendation of rebuild/m2/AUDIT-REGISTER.md becomes an approved repair direction: D1 APPROVED-FIX · D2 APPROVED-FIX · D3 APPROVED-FIX · D4 APPROVED-FIX · D5 APPROVED-FIX · D6 APPROVED-FIX · D7 APPROVED-FIX · D9 APPROVED-FIX · D11 APPROVED-FIX · D12 APPROVED-FIX · D13 APPROVED-FIX · D14 APPROVED-FIX · D15 APPROVED-FIX · D17 APPROVED-FIX · D18 APPROVED-FIX · D19 APPROVED-FIX · D20 APPROVED-FIX · D21 APPROVED-FIX · D22 APPROVED-FIX · D23 APPROVED-FIX · D24 APPROVED-FIX · D26 APPROVED-FIX · D27 APPROVED-FIX · D28 APPROVED-FIX · D29 APPROVED-FIX · D30 APPROVED-FIX · D31 APPROVED-FIX · D33 APPROVED-FIX · D34 APPROVED-FIX · D35 APPROVED-FIX · D36 APPROVED-FIX · D38 APPROVED-FIX · D39 APPROVED-FIX · D41 APPROVED-FIX · D42 APPROVED-FIX · D43 APPROVED-FIX · D44 APPROVED-FIX · D45 APPROVED-FIX (38). BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set. Transport: the route ruling at line 42 applies; no additional Go was requested or given · rebuild/m2/OWNER-RULING-PACK-M2.md · M2-RULE DONE; M2-FIX unblocked for briefs (D33–D35 first, per the accepted PR #34 contract)

All 206 paths the parent artifact rebuild/m4/spec/acceptance-s7-port-admission.json pins were read from disk at this head and hashed against S7's own recorded post: 24 moved and 182 agree, 0 unexplained, so every `pre` here is the parent's own post. THE SEVEN TOOLING FACTS, MIRRORED FROM THE S7-TOOLING ROUND (DECISIONS:511, :515) AND LANDED BY S8-PREP. The refusal chain and the diff per file are in rebuild/lanes/b/S8-PREP-AUTHOR-REPORT.md. (1) IDS at b-package.cjs was [B-NTC,H3,S3,S4,S5,S6,S7,B1,B2,B4,B3] and the argv gate at :581 refused any other id outright (B PACKAGE USAGE REFUSED, exit 1, before this spec was opened); S8 now stands directly behind S7, twelve ids. (2) NO_REGISTER_IDS gains S8; S8 is an S- id, so the shape assertion admits it without a PM by-name ruling, exactly as S3, S4, S5, S6 and S7 were admitted. (3) CHILD_ROOTS gains rebuild/lanes/d/p3-real-shape/ as its twentieth root, without which the declared child `d-real-shape` is refused CHILD-ARGV-TARGET and the Y1 own-child obligation (MIN_OWN_CHILDREN = 1) cannot be met at all; the root is deliberately NOT added to PUBLIC_TAIL_ROOTS, for the same reason p3-port-fix is not. (4) The five s8-supersede-*.test.cjs cells and s8-engine-files-differential.cjs now exist beside the s7-* family, each copied byte for byte from its s7 sibling and changed only where S7-TOOLING changed the s6 ones (S7 -> S8, the parent M2-S6-TODAY-CHILD -> M2-S7-PORT-ADMISSION, the parent token line DECISIONS:490 -> :514, packages/S7.json -> S8.json), because the s7-* family reads packages/S7.json by path and a retirement is never inherited - only the gate list is. (5) Moving b-package.cjs moves tooling.runnerSha256, so packages/H3.json, S3.json, S4.json, S5.json and S6.json are re-pinned role `edited` and packages/S7.json is role `superseded-by-child` over the parent EXECUTION pin. (6) F6 and F7 in rebuild/lanes/b/tooling/test/pinned-unchanged-and-ruled-substitutions.test.cjs take the new lists by literal and by deepEqual: IDS of twelve, NO_REGISTER_IDS of eight, CHILD_ROOTS of twenty. (7) The five CHILD_SPECS cells (measure/test/boundary.test.mjs, today/test/food.test.mjs, today/test/machine-settings-ui.test.mjs, today/test/problem.test.mjs, today/test/setup.test.mjs) gain the S8 literal; this is also the fact that turns the five today byte-pin cells DECISIONS:523 left red green, because it is what gives today-bindings.mjs and workout-host.mjs a declaring package.

THE NEEDLES ARE MEASURED, NOT CARRIED. All 25 children were run on this head the way children() runs them (node, cwd = the worktree, TZ=America/New_York, MEASURED_TEST_NOW=2026-09-03), and each needle here is what its own run printed. The table of S7's value against the measured value, child by child, is in rebuild/lanes/b/S8-PREP-AUTHOR-REPORT.md; not one needle in this file was typed from a report.

THE NINE GATES ARE RETIRED AGAIN, a sixth time, and the reason is structural rather than this package's doing. The nine NATIVE-CARRIERS gates are byte-identity RECONSTRUCTIONS of rebuild/engine from a frozen BASE; four of the files they rebuild were moved by this package's ancestors (constants.cjs and writers.cjs by M2-H3-CLEAN-INIT, merge.cjs and today.cjs by M2-S3-COMPANION), so no descendant of S3 can carry them whether or not it moves an engine byte of its own. S8 moves none: all 45 tracked engine files stand at the parent's own post. The parent retired them under its own token line DECISIONS:514; a retirement is never inherited, only the gate list is, so this package retires them AGAIN under its OWN token line with its OWN evidence in S7's exact shape.

THE SEALING WINDOW, AND WHY NO CELL IS EDITED FOR IT. VERDICT-S6.md rule (b) and DECISIONS:499: standingSeal(repoRoot) reads the standing package off the CI flag. With the flag at S8 and receipts/S8.json absent, the window branch applies: packages/S8.json must exist and be BRIEF-ACCEPTED and name a parent.chosen whose receipt exists. It does - S7, receipts/S7.json sha256 3fd8d36bd4268f145b6feb8052710efca41660a8539b490f212421a9ab4013f1 - so the constant must equal M2-S7-PORT-ADMISSION@3fd8d36bd4268f14, which is exactly where rebuild/coach/engine-revision.cjs stands and where it stays for the whole of this window. P3-M3 in rebuild/m4/import/test/production-mapping.test.cjs, the coach cell rebuild/coach/test/engine-revision.test.cjs and P3-P6-SEAL-WINDOW in production-admission.test.mjs all read that rule and all stay GREEN through the window; they become trip-wires again the moment receipts/S8.json lands. This package edits none of them and carries all three byte-identical.

This package registers no D-id (DECISIONS:93, the S- slice-plan half); its obligation is the Y1 own-child rule, satisfied by the `d-real-shape` child that executes six of its own role:new cells under the child root rebuild/lanes/d/p3-real-shape/ this round added.
